policy: Select the verified input allowance of the actual gateway route. Keep native model limits, optional extended windows, and TPM separate. Unknown models fail closed; never fall back to 64000.

openai-subscription.metadata_source: authenticated official /models, forwarded by private /admin/models; gateway-model-metadata.json

google-gemini.metadata_source: Google models.list catalog and existing gateway /v1/models

gpt-5.6-luna.selection_basis: Actual subscription catalog max_input_tokens/context_window. The optional max_context_window is recorded, not assumed enabled. Public API limits do not replace account-route metadata.

gpt-5.6-terra.selection_basis: Actual subscription catalog max_input_tokens/context_window; optional extended window not assumed enabled.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.selection_basis: Google model input limit is 1048576. Existing scheduler rejects any single input larger than per-project TPM250000. The usable route allowance is250000 until that gateway quota changes; this is not a model context limit.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite.selection_basis: Native1048576; existing gateway single-request scheduler ceiling250000. Preserve the distinction between model capacity and route quota.
